english.title: Publish material intended / likely to identify a child involved in family court proceedings or their address / school
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) published to

(A)_[the public at large]_
(B)_[a section of the public, namely **(..SPECIFY SECTION..),]_

material which was intended, or was likely, to identify

(C)_[a child as being]_
(D)_[an address as being that of a child]_
(E)_[a school as being that of a child]_

involved in proceedings before

(F)_[the High Court]_
(G)_[a county court]_
(H)_[a magistrates court]_
(I)_[the Family Court]_

in which a power under the

(J)_[Children Act 1989]_
(K)_[Adoption and Children Act 2002]_

may be exercised by the court with respect to that or another child
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(2) and (6) of the Children Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
publish material intended / likely to identify a child
involved in court proceedings under the Children Act 1989 / Adoption and Children Act 2002
or their address / school

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In any proceedings for an offence under this section, it shall be a defence for the accused to prove that he did not know, and had no reason to suspect, that the published material was intended, or likely, to identify the child - section 97(3)
(ii) For the purposes of this section 'publish' includes -

(a) include a programme service (within the meaning of the Broadcasting Act 1990); or
(b) cause to be published; and (iii) 'material' includes any picture or representation
